# regapi_domain (Resource)

Settings of a domain that is already registered in the account. Creating the resource adopts the domain; destroying it only removes it from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "regapi_domain" "client" {
  name        = "client.gr"
  nameservers = ["ns1.example.net", "ns2.example.net"]
  auto_renew  = true

  # Same holder only: a registrant of a different holder needs a trade, which RegAPI does not
  # support yet.
  admin_contact_id = regapi_contact.agency.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name, for example acme.gr.

### Optional

- `admin_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the administrative contact. Left out: left as it is.
- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether RegAPI renews the domain before it expires.
- `billing_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the billing contact. Left out: left as it is.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameservers. Left out: left as they are.
- `registrant_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the registrant contact. Left out: left as it is.
- `tech_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the technical contact. Left out: left as it is.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `expiry_date` (String) Expiry date and time.
- `nameservers_source` (String) default when the registrar's nameservers are used, else custom.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase, for example Active.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
